plugin.name: xWeatherRouting
plugin.summary: Advanced weather routing with departure and arrival planning.
plugin.author: Sean d'Epagnier; Weather Routing Plugin Team
plugin.description: WeatherRouting offers Quick, Standard and Professional engines with independent saved settings and explicit search presets. Quick uses hardened contour routing with independent chronological validation. Standard provides bounded adaptive search; Professional adds broader recovery methods. All support plugin-managed GSHHG shorelines; optional chart-backed safety requires a compatible host.
